name: Keyline
feature_notes: Keyline standardizes saved-account AutoFill metadata across fleet owner, appointed Captain and Admiral password sign-in fields. Apple controls Face ID or Touch ID for saved credentials. Existing server role, vessel membership, PIN, session and recovery checks are unchanged. No passkey enrollment or biometric authentication protocol is added. See KEYLINE_GUIDE.md.

backend_prerequisite.reason: Countercraft tables, private storage and exact-vessel gateway verified. TrueFit service v2 deployed; Sea Trial remains enabled only by owner publication.
